name: Michal (Saul's daughter)
title: David's first wife
summary: Michal was King Saul's youngest daughter and David's first wife. She loved David and saved his life from her father's murder plots, but the marriage ended in bitterness when she despised David for his worship of God.

keyEvents.title: Michal is promised to David
keyEvents.description: King Saul offered Michal as a wife to David in exchange for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, hoping that David would be killed. David paid double the amount.

keyEvents.title: Michal Saves David's Life
keyEvents.description: When Saul sent men to kill David, Michal helped him escape through the window and deceived the soldiers with a household idol in the bed.

keyEvents.title: Michal Is Given to Another Man
keyEvents.description: While David was fleeing, Saul gave Michal to Paltiel son of Laish as his wife.

keyEvents.title: Michal Is Brought Back to David
keyEvents.description: When David became king over Judah, he demanded Michal back as part of an agreement with Abner. Paltiel followed her weeping.

keyEvents.title: Michal Despises David
keyEvents.description: When the ark of the covenant was brought to Jerusalem and David danced for joy before the Lord, Michal despised him in her heart for what she saw as unworthy behavior.

keyEvents.title: Michal Remains Childless
keyEvents.description: As a result of her contempt for David's worship, Michal had no children until the day of her death.
